    Loop-free ray categories #

    A ray category is loop-free when every nonzero endomorphism has trivial homotopy class. This passes to the reduction P/⟨αᵢ⟩ of Lemma 2.2 (loopFree_quot, via Φ ⋙ Ψ = 𝟭) and to the opposite category (loopFree_op).
